title: The descended compatible map is an epimorphism
statement:
theorem etaleResidueTriples_primeLocalization_component_extension_epi
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (p : Spec R) (K : Type u) [Field K]
    (χ : (Spec R).residueField p ⟶ CommRingCat.of K)
    (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)))
    (ψ : (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).residueField q ⟶
      CommRingCat.of K)
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K]
    (_hψ : (ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).inv ≫
      (Spec (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal))).Γevaluation q ≫ ψ =
        CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K))
    (_hK : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫
      CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) K) =
        (ΓSpecIso R).inv ≫ (Spec R).Γevaluation p ≫ χ)
    (t : EtaleResidueTriples (CommRingCat.of (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) q K ψ)
    (c : EtaleResidueTriples R p K χ) (i : c.B ⟶ t.B)
    (_hα : c.α ≫ i = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal)) ≫ t.α)
    (_hφ : i ≫ (ΓSpecIso t.B).inv ≫ (Spec t.B).Γevaluation t.q ≫ t.φ =
      (ΓSpecIso c.B).inv ≫ (Spec c.B).Γevaluation c.q ≫ c.φ)
    (M : Submonoid c.B)
    (hlocal : letI := i.hom.toAlgebra; IsLocalization M t.B) : Epi i

proof.text: Use the algebra structure induced by i.hom. The explicit hlocal hypothesis makes t.B a localization of c.B at M for exactly this structure. Apply Mathlib IsLocalization.epi M t.B; its canonical algebraMap is definitionally i. This uses localization ring-hom extensionality and requires none of the pointing compatibility equations.

statement_change.what: E2 repair: compatibility alone is insufficient, as the pointed diagonal F → F × F shows. Add a submonoid M and IsLocalization M t.B for the algebra structure induced by i; this ensures i is the canonical localization map. Underscore unused compatibility binder names without changing their types.

citers.note: The arbitrary compatible model lacks localization data. Its unchanged existence statement is restored as an explicit descent obligation; the invalid application is removed in the same delivery.

old_proof.text: Apply finite-presentation descent and the affine localization epimorphism argument.
